# Part III: Management {.unnumbered .part}

# Use in an MSE

`flicc.sa()` wraps `fiticc()` as the estimation step of an `mse` management
procedure, with `lbi.hcr()`, `rfb.flicc.hcr()` and `flicc.is()` for the
harvest control rule and implementation:

```{r mse, eval = FALSE}
est <- mseCtrl(method = flicc.sa, args = list(
  lhpar = lhpar, sel_fun = sel_fun, ess.g = NULL,   # raw counts
  settings = list(obs_model = "dm", dm_theta = "saturating", CVL = 0.1,
                  sigmaF = 0.3,      # fixed (or the F_re estimate from the real data)
                  tail_cut = 47,     # absolute length, the same in every iteration
                  spr_ref = 40),
  spr = 40))
```

- `se = FALSE` is used inside `flicc.sa()`; fixed sigmaF avoids its estimation in
  every year and iteration.
- The tail cut and sigmaF both trade responsiveness against stability; tune them
  together with the smoothing of the harvest control rule.
- Expect the equilibrium model to be pessimistic during a rebuild and optimistic
  while F increases.
